description:
List the organization's connectors: each one's name, kind, transport, catalog entry, and description. It is the discovery step before attach_connector.

Pass name to judge each connector against one website, app, or agent: every row then says whether that service can hold the connector and whether it holds it now. A website can hold only an mcp-server connector on the sse or streamable-http transport, because a page reaches a connector through Valet's gateway; the rows a website cannot hold are marked, not hidden. An agent can hold any of them. An app cannot hold a connector yet.

Tool schemas are not included: to see a connector's tools, call list_connector_tools with the connector's name. Attach a connector to a website only when the user asks to give the site's pages access, since attaching hands the connector's reach to everyone who can open the site. Requires connecting a Valet account.

name.description: The website's, app's, or agent's name. Each row then says whether it can hold the connector and whether it holds it now. Omit for the plain organization-wide list.

org_name.description: The Valet organization whose connectors to list. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_connectors

connectors.description: The organization's connectors. Empty when it has none.

attached.description: True when the service named in the call already holds this connector. Absent when false or when the call named no service.

can_hold.description: Whether the service named in the call can hold this connector. Absent when the call named no service.

catalog.description: Name of the catalog entry the connector came from. Absent for a custom connector.

description.description: The catalog entry's description. Absent for a custom connector or one whose catalog entry is no longer live.

kind.description: The connector's type: mcp-server or command.

name.description: The connector's name, which attach_connector takes.

transport.description: How the connector's server is reached, such as streamable-http or sse. Absent for a command connector.

kind.description: Kind of the service named in name: site, app, or agent. Absent when the call named none.

name.description: Name of the website, app, or agent the can_hold and attached markers are judged against. Absent when the call named none.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

title: List the organization's connectors
